## Frequently asked questions

### Where is Sukra Jewellery?
72, North Mada Street, Mylapore, Chennai 600 004 (Monday to Saturday, 10.00 am to 8.30 pm · closed Sundays).

### What facilities does Sukra Jewellery have?
Silver jewellery, Temple jewellery, Antique jewellery, Heirloom collection, Kaaviyam collection, Silverware, Gift articles, Pooja articles, Designer jewels, BIS silver hallmarking.

### What does Sukra sell?
Silver jewellery, temple jewellery, antique jewellery, silverware, pooja articles, gift articles and designer jewels.

### Is Sukra's silver hallmarked?
Sukra was the first retailer in South India to obtain the BIS silver hallmarking licence.

### How do I visit Sukra Jewellery?
We're at 72, North Mada Street, Mylapore, open Monday to Saturday, 10 am to 8.30 pm. Call +91 44 2464 0699.
